First week in Thailand (7 days)

A first week has one fork after Bangkok. North for temples and food. South for a beach. Pick with the monsoon, not with a map that shows both.

Duration7 days
ForkChiang Mai or one coast
Do notTwo island groups

Three nights in Bangkok is enough. The remaining four nights belong to one other place.

Day by day

1

Bangkok arrival

Airport car or ARL. Sukhumvit sleep.

2

Palace morning

Rattanakosin early, river boat, dinner in Thonglor.

3

City buffer

Siam, Chinatown, or a rest day. Fly or train tonight if you take the sleeper north.

4

Fork day

Chiang Mai Old City, or a HKT/USM/KBV landing and a beach transfer.

5

Deepen the fork

Nimman or a boat day. Not a new city.

6

Second full day away

This is the day the trip needed.

7

Return and out

Fly back to BKK only if the long-haul needs it. Same-day international is a gamble.

Common questions

North or south on a first week?
North if you care about food and wats. South if you need a beach. The 14-day plan is how you do both.
